sections.title: Sound of yo
paragraphs: The letter name is (ё) /jo/. Its main sound is heard in (ёлка) /ˈjɵlkə/, which means fir tree, Christmas tree. This letter has three sounds. It is always stressed in standard words.

sections.title: How to say yo
paragraphs: Start with the front of the tongue high near the roof of the mouth. Glide smoothly into a mid vowel while you push your lips forward into a small circle. Next, raise the middle of the tongue toward the roof of the mouth and make the same vowel. Finally, keep your tongue back and purse your lips. Touch your throat to feel the voice buzz.

sections.title: Spelling rules for yo
paragraphs: At the start of a word, after another vowel, or after signs, it sounds like (ёж) /jɵʂ/ or (моё) /mɐˈjo/. After a paired soft consonant, it makes the consonant palatalized, as in (мёд) /mʲɵt/ or (лёд) /lʲɵt/. After hard hissing consonants, it sounds like (жёлтый) /ˈʐoltɨj/ or (шёл) /ʂol/.

sections.title: Comparing yo to English
paragraphs: Do not turn the sound into a diphthong like the vowel in boat. Keep your mouth steady once the vowel begins. Form a neat circle with your lips instead of spreading them wide. Do not drop the starting y sound in words that begin like (ёж) /jɵʂ/.
